title: Reusable cluster access and compatibility-aware host selection
summary: Noninteractive access and load-aware host advice support engineering automation across cluster environments.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Developed reusable cluster-access tools spanning noninteractive SSH, optional TTYs, configurable transport settings and temporary authentication helpers with credentials kept out of command arguments.
Built a compatibility-aware host advisor using bounded noninteractive OS/load probes and ranking across a default pool of 35 login hosts in two cluster environments.
Developed macOS cluster-storage helpers that validate working-directory containment and support host resolution, status and unmount operations.

notes: The 35-host pool is configured orchestration scope, not a measured scale or throughput outcome.
No numerical transfer-throughput improvement or enterprise-wide identity service is established.
